I came to Dr. Manjiri just three weeks before my due date — a last-minute switch from my original doctor who had to travel during my birth.

I had an unmedicated water birth, overdue, with a cord around my baby, and yet I walked away feeling like my body had been trusted and my birth had been honoured. That is an extraordinary thing to be able to say.

If you are looking for a doctor who will hold space for the birth you hope for — rather than the one that's most convenient — Dr. Manjiri is who you want in that room.
